chunk.content: Gulamah (Johnius trachycephalus) is processed into salted fish; the feasibility of salted gulamah fish processing in Perlis Village, Langkat Regency (medium- and micro-scale businesses) was analysed.
chunk.source_quote: This study aimed to determine the feasibility of processing salted gulamah fish in Perlis Village, Langkat Regency.

source.title: Business Analysis of Gulamah (Johnius trachycephalus) Salted Fish Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Perlis, Berandan Barat, Langkat, North Sumatera
